system.description:
Engaged with Target. Difficulty is (2{Dc}) if target critically wounded. Add {Df} if target of check is self.

Immediate Care: Recover 1 wound for each 4+ on a L L to a maximum of target’s Toughness. Causes 1 stress and 1 fatigue. Ignore Critical Wound: If equals the critical’s severity, target may ignore that critical for the remainder of the day. Causes 1 stress, 1 fatigue, and 1 normal wound. Assist Overnight Resilience Check: Target gains +10 for each success. HUR Target may benefit from each specific source of healing once per day (PG:89)
